features: Mobile NVR for vehicles and rail; TRM-1610M uses M12 connectors instead of RJ-45
Recording compression: H.265, H.264, MJPEG, WiseStream (H.265, H.264)
Internal storage: max. 2TB (HDD), max. 4TB (SSD), non-RAID mode
Internal Wi-Fi (802.11n 2.4GHz / ac 5GHz) for automatic backup
notes: Power consumption stated as 67W (maximum) at room temperature, 93W at low temperature in use and 144W at low temperature at start.
Operating temperature -25°C to +55°C applies with HDD in use; the specification gives -40°C to +70°C with an industrial SSD.
USB stated as 3 (1 x M12, 2 x USB-A), except for the M12 model with built-in LTE module. USB port count left out.
